Name: Lake Louise Park & Ride
Description: MANDATORY departure point for Moraine Lake and Lake Louise shuttles — personal vehicles not permitted at the lakes. Free parking with shuttle reservation. Reserve at reservation.pc.gc.ca. Aug 20 slots open on Aug 18 at 8am MDT on a rolling 2-day window. Book the moment slots open.

Name: Moraine Lake
Description: One of the most intense lake-and-peak scenes anywhere. The Valley of the Ten Peaks above a deep turquoise lake. Take the Rockpile trail (15 min) for the postcard view. Shuttle only from Lake Louise Park & Ride.

Name: Lake Louise
Description: Classic glacier lake beneath Victoria Glacier. Walk the lakeshore (easy). Shuttle from Lake Louise Park & Ride. Less dramatic than Moraine but still excellent — do in the afternoon after Moraine.

Name: Lake Agnes Tea House
Description: Alpine lake above Lake Louise with a working 1901 tea house at the top. One of the best short hikes in Banff. 7 km return, 385m gain from Lake Louise lakeshore. Order a tea.

Name: Lake O'Hara
Description: Probably the strongest possible upgrade if you can get bus access. Elite alpine basin with multiple turquoise lakes and high routes. Bus and campsite reservations are extremely scarce — check reservation.pc.gc.ca early.

Name: Spiral Tunnels viewpoint
Description: CPR rail line loops through the mountains in a double figure-eight spiral to descend the grade. Pull over above Field BC on the Trans-Canada. Best if a freight train is actively passing through — extraordinary engineering in dramatic scenery.

Name: Natural Bridge
Description: Kicking Horse River carved a natural arch through solid rock. Vivid green glacial water. Quick 10 min stop near the Emerald Lake road junction in Yoho.

Name: Takakkaw Falls
Description: One of Canada's tallest waterfalls at 384m exploding off a hanging valley. Yoho Valley Road is seasonal but fine for an SUV — no trailers. Walk 30 min to the base. The road itself is dramatic.

Name: Emerald Lake
Description: Most intensely coloured lake in Yoho — a deep tropical green ringed by forest and peaks. 5.2 km shoreline loop (flat, 1.5 hrs). Canoe rental available. Arrive early or late for parking.
